name: Can I diagnose high water pressure myself before calling a plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I diagnose high water pressure myself before calling a plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can purchase a water pressure gauge at a hardware store and attach it to an outdoor spigot to get a general reading, a DIY diagnosis might not uncover the full extent or specific cause of the issue. A professional plumber from CG Plumbing Solutions can accurately pinpoint the source, assess the condition of your PRV, and recommend the most effective, long-term solution, which is crucial for preventing future problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can use a DIY gauge, but professional plumbers offer a comprehensive diagnosis to accurately pinpoint the cause and recommend effective solutions.
